entries.name: Add State(s) to Queue__jki_lib_state_machine
entries.vi_path: addons/_JKI Toolkits/State Machine/_JKI_lib_State_Machine.llb/Add State(s) to Queue__jki_lib_state_machine.vi
entries.description: JKI State Machine: joins State(s) in Front, State(s) in and State(s) at Back into States Out, each trimmed of leading and trailing tabs, line feeds, carriage returns and spaces, with a line feed between the parts that are not empty.

entries.name: Parse State Queue__jki_lib_state_machine
entries.vi_path: addons/_JKI Toolkits/State Machine/_JKI_lib_State_Machine.llb/Parse State Queue__jki_lib_state_machine.vi
entries.description: JKI State Machine: takes the first state off State Queue. Blank lines and text after //, # or /* on a line are skipped, and the state is split at >> into Current State and Arguments. An error in gives the state Error Handler.
entries.python_code:
{remaining_states} = {state_queue}
{current_state} = ''
{arguments} = ''
if {error_in} is not None and {error_in}.status:
    {current_state} = 'Error Handler'
elif {state_queue} != '':
    _queue = {state_queue}
    while True:
        _end = re.search('[\r\n]+', _queue)
        _line = _queue if _end is None else _queue[:_end.start()]
        _rest = '' if _end is None else _queue[_end.end():]
        _comment = min([len(_line)] + [_at for _at in (_line.find('//'), _line.find('#'), _line.find('/*')) if _at >= 0])
        _text = _line[:_comment].lstrip(' \t').rstrip(' \t')
        _queue = _rest.lstrip(' \t').rstrip(' \t\r\n')
        _split = re.search('[ \t]*>>[ \t]*', _text)
        _state = _text if _split is None else _text[:_split.start()]
        _arguments = '' if _split is None else _text[_split.end():]
        if _queue == '' or _state != '':
            break
    {remaining_states} = _queue
    {current_state} = _state
    {arguments} = _arguments

entries.name: Start CLI Interface
entries.vi_path: Wiresmith Technology/G CLI/CLI Class/Start CLI Interface.vi
entries.description: G CLI: gives the program's own command-line arguments (those after -- when it is started by G CLI) as Custom Parameters and the directory it was started from as Working Directory. With an error in, Custom Parameters is empty and Working Directory is /C. CLI out is None: a Python program has no connection to a command-line launcher.
entries.python_code:
{cli_out} = None
if {error_in} is not None and {error_in}.status:
    {custom_parameters} = []
    {working_directory} = Path('C:/')
else:
    {custom_parameters} = sys.argv[1:]
    {working_directory} = Path.cwd()

entries.name: Exit With Error Cluster Code
entries.vi_path: Wiresmith Technology/G CLI/CLI Class/Exit With Error Cluster Code.vi
entries.description: G CLI: ends the program with an exit code. With an error in whose status is True, it writes the error to standard error between lines of = signs and exits with the error's code; otherwise (no error, or a warning) it exits with No Error Code.
entries.python_code:
if {error_in} is not None and {error_in}.status:
    sys.stderr.write('==============
Error At Exit:
' + str({error_in}) + '
==============
')
    sys.exit({error_in}.code)
sys.exit({no_error_code})

entries.name: Get LV Enum Value from Proto Value

entries.description: gRPC library: the LabVIEW enum value (the position of the item in the enum's registered list) of a proto enum number; error -2003 for a number the enum does not hold.

entries.name: Get Proto Enum Value from LV Value
entries.vi_path: gRPC/LabVIEW gRPC Library/Shared/Get Proto Enum Value from LV Value.vi
entries.description: gRPC library: the proto enum number of the item at a LabVIEW enum value in the enum's registered list; error -2003 for a value past the list.

entries.name: Create Client
entries.vi_path: gRPC/LabVIEW gRPC Library/Client API/Create Client.vi
entries.description: gRPC library: a client of the server at address; with a certificate path the connection uses SSL with that root certificate. In Python the client is a grpcio channel.

entries.name: Close Client
entries.vi_path: gRPC/LabVIEW gRPC Library/Client API/Close Client.vi
entries.description: gRPC library: closes the client; in Python, the grpcio channel.

entries.name: Client Unary Call.vim
entries.vi_path: gRPC/LabVIEW gRPC Library/Client API/Client Unary Call.vim
entries.description: gRPC library: calls a unary method of the server with the request message and reads the response message; a failed call is error -(1000 + the gRPC status code). In Python it is a grpcio unary_unary call on the message classes of the _pb2 modules.

entries.name: Client Begin Server Streaming Call.vim
entries.vi_path: gRPC/LabVIEW gRPC Library/Client API/Client Begin Server Streaming Call.vim
entries.description: gRPC library: starts a server-streaming call of the method with the request message; the call ID is the grpcio call, which Client Read From Stream reads. A call that fails reports its status when it completes.

entries.name: Client Read From Stream.vim
entries.vi_path: gRPC/LabVIEW gRPC Library/Client API/Client Read From Stream.vim
entries.description: gRPC library: reads the next message of the call; Success is False when the stream has ended (or failed: Client Complete Streaming Call reports the status) and Response Data is then the Response Type.

entries.name: Client Complete Streaming Call.vi
entries.vi_path: gRPC/LabVIEW gRPC Library/Client API/Client Complete Streaming Call.vi
entries.description: gRPC library: waits for the call to finish and reports its status as error -(1000 + the gRPC status code); with Cancel All Reads True it cancels the call instead (no error).

entries.name: Client Cancel Call.vi
entries.vi_path: gRPC/LabVIEW gRPC Library/Client API/Client Cancel Call.vi
entries.description: gRPC library: cancels the call (the grpcio call's cancel).

entries.name: Register Message Metadata
entries.vi_path: gRPC/LabVIEW gRPC Library/Server API/Server/Register Message Metadata.vi
entries.description: gRPC library: records metadata for the library's client; the _pb2 module of the messages does that in Python, so the id passes on.

entries.name: Register Enum Metadata
entries.vi_path: gRPC/LabVIEW gRPC Library/Server API/Server/Register Enum Metadata.vi
entries.description: gRPC library: records metadata for the library's client; the _pb2 module of the messages does that in Python, so the id passes on.

entries.name: CompleteMetadataRegistration
entries.vi_path: gRPC/LabVIEW gRPC Library/Server API/CompleteMetadataRegistration.vi
entries.description: gRPC library: records metadata for the library's client; the _pb2 module of the messages does that in Python, so the id passes on.

entries.name: PackToAny.vim
entries.vi_path: gRPC/LabVIEW gRPC Library/Server API/Message Requests/PackToAny.vim
entries.description: gRPC library: makes the message named by Message Type from the cluster and gives the Any cluster: Type Url is '/' and the message's full proto name, Bytes the serialized message. In Python the message is the protobuf class of the _pb2 module.

entries.name: UnpackFromAny.vim
entries.vi_path: gRPC/LabVIEW gRPC Library/Server API/Message Requests/UnpackFromAny.vim
entries.description: gRPC library: parses Bytes of the Any as the message named by Message Type (Type Url is not read) and gives it as the Data Type cluster; bytes that do not parse are error -2. In Python the message is the protobuf class of the _pb2 module.

entries.name: Cluster to gRPC LabVIEW Message.vi
entries.vi_path: gRPC/LabVIEW gRPC Library/Server API/Cluster to gRPC message/Cluster to gRPC LabVIEW Message.vi
entries.description: gRPC library: describes the messages and enums of a cluster's type for the library's C++ side; the _pb2 classes do that in Python, so both arrays are empty.

entries.name: Register Reflection Descriptors.vi
entries.vi_path: gRPC/LabVIEW gRPC Library/Server API/Server/Register Reflection Descriptors.vi
entries.description: gRPC library: hands the library the file descriptors its server's reflection service answers with; the generated server does not serve reflection, so the id passes on.

entries.name: Create Server.vi
entries.vi_path: gRPC/LabVIEW gRPC Library/Server API/Server/Create Server.vi
entries.description: gRPC library: makes a server. In Python the server id is the Server of the package's grpc_server module, on grpcio.

entries.name: Start Server.vi
entries.vi_path: gRPC/LabVIEW gRPC Library/Server API/Server/Start Server.vi
entries.description: gRPC library: starts the server listening on the address (0.0.0.0:50051 when it is empty), with TLS from the certificate and key files when the certificate path is longer than one character, and returns the port. A server that cannot start is error -8001.

entries.name: Stop Server.vi
entries.vi_path: gRPC/LabVIEW gRPC Library/Server API/Server/Stop Server.vi
entries.description: gRPC library: stops the server and cancels the calls in progress at once.

entries.name: Create And Register Server Event.vim
entries.vi_path: gRPC/LabVIEW gRPC Library/Server API/Server/Create And Register Server Event.vim
entries.description: gRPC library: makes the user event a call of the method arrives on and registers it with the server; the first registration of a method is the one kept. The request and response message names give the Python classes of the messages.

entries.name: Read Call Request.vim
entries.vi_path: gRPC/LabVIEW gRPC Library/Server API/Message Requests/Read Call Request.vim
entries.description: gRPC library: reads the next request message of the call. A read that gets none is error -(1000 + the call's status), -1001 for a cancelled call, else -2.

entries.name: Write Call Response.vim
entries.vi_path: gRPC/LabVIEW gRPC Library/Server API/Message Requests/Write Call Response.vim
entries.description: gRPC library: sends one response message of the call. A write to a call that is over is error -(1000 + the call's status), -1001 for a cancelled call, else -2.

entries.name: Complete Call.vi
entries.vi_path: gRPC/LabVIEW gRPC Library/Server API/Message Requests/Complete Call.vi
entries.description: gRPC library: ends the call with its status; a call that is over stays as it is.

entries.name: Set Call Status.vi
entries.vi_path: gRPC/LabVIEW gRPC Library/Server API/Set Call Status.vi
entries.description: gRPC library: sets the status the call ends with.

entries.name: Is Call Cancelled.vi
entries.vi_path: gRPC/LabVIEW gRPC Library/Server API/Message Requests/Is Call Cancelled.vi
entries.description: gRPC library: whether the call ended before it was completed: the client cancelled it, its deadline passed, or the server stopped.
